mechanism: Estradiol inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing fluphenazine plasma concentrations and risk of antipsychotic adverse effects; estrogen also increases thrombotic risk which may be compounded by antipsychotic effects on coagulation.
action: Monitor for increased extrapyramidal symptoms, tardive dyskinesia, and thrombotic events; consider fluphenazine dose reduction if adverse effects emerge; assess thrombotic risk factors periodically.
